en:
Over there—it's Maki. She was one of the
people I saw in the Game Room...
Let's ask her what she was doing.

It looks like she's in the back...
Let's try talking to her.

Let's try asking other people questions.
There are people we haven't talked to yet.

Maki...you were in the Game Room when
Rantaro was killed, right?

What were you all doing down here?
Rantaro was with you, right?
...Am I a suspect?
Oh, no! That's not what I meant—

You should suspect me. In fact, you should
be suspicious of everyone.
Huh?

Someone got killed right after we all gathered
here. The timing is too perfect.

Then again, with the time limit so close to
expiring, maybe that's why it happened...

So trust no one, Kaede...
Or you'll lose, got it?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't get a read on Maki at all. She just saw
a dead body, yet she's perfectly calm.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's hard to imagine her as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child
Caregiver<CLT=cltMIND>.

But...why were you all here
in the first place?

It was Kaito's idea. He suddenly wanted to hold
a strategy meeting and gathered us together.

He said we should confront Monokuma once
the time limit expires.

And he picked the seven people he thought
would be useful in a fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>Seven people... Kaito, Gonta, Maki, Tenko,
Himiko, Angie, and Rantaro...

But, um...I'm not sure those seven would all
be useful in a fight, though.

Kaito thought Himiko's magic and Angie's
connection to Atua would be useful.

But what about you, Maki? Why did he also
pick the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Child Caregiver<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

...He just looked at me and said, "Yeah, you
probably know how to fight."

<CLT=cltMIND>That's it? Geez... That does sound like
something Kaito would do, though...

But why have a strategy meeting
in the Game Room in the basement?

...Beats me. Maybe Kaito figured it would be
harder for Monokuma to find us here.
<CLT=cltMIND>In other words, it was just a coincidence?

And what was Rantaro doing at the time?
Was he in the strategy meeting with you?
He was...at first.

But then he excused himself to go to the
bathroom, and left on his own...

Kaito and Tenko went looking for him so we
could finish the meeting before time expired.
<CLT=cltMIND>That must've happened around...
Huh? What are you guys doing here?

Well, never mind. Your timing's perfect.
You should join our strategy meeting.
Kaede is definitely welcome to join!

Then, did the four of you just wait in the
Game Room the whole time?

Angie, Himiko, and I were the only ones who
stayed behind. Gonta never joined us.
...Huh? Gonta wasn't with you guys?

Gonta did arrive, but then he left and locked
himself in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>A/V Room in the back<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
He was in the A/V Room by himself?

Suspicious behavior, isn't it? The other two
felt the same way.
What other two?

Why don't you go to the A/V Room?
They're probably still there...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Maki's Account<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
Kaito was the one who gathered us here.

He said we should confront Monokuma once
the time limit expires.

And he picked the seven people he thought
would be useful in a fight.

<CLT=cltMIND>Seven people... Kaito, Gonta, Maki, Tenko,
Himiko, Angie, and Rantaro...

<CLT=cltMIND>It sounds it was just a coincidence that
this meeting was held in the Game Room.

Rantaro said he was going
to the bathroom, correct?

But because time was about to expire, 
Kaito and Tenko went to get him.
<CLT=cltMIND>That must've happened around...
Huh? What are you guys doing here?

Well, never mind. Your timing's perfect.
You should join our strategy meeting.
Kaede is definitely welcome to join!

And when Gonta arrived, he just locked
himself in the A/V Room?

Suspicious behavior, isn't it? The other two
felt the same way.
What other two?

Why don't you go to the A/V Room?
They're probably still there...
Were those two still there?
Yeah...I didn't wanna get involved...
Smart move. Just hearing it wore me out.

It's true that talking to Himiko and the
others was unavoidable...

...but there were a lot of other points of
interest that caught my eye in that room.
Your enthusiasm is...odd.
Huh?

You're livelier now that a crime has occurred.
Must be because you're a detective.
Th-That's not...

No, you're just seeing how reliable Shuichi
has become.

I don't think it has anything to do with him
being a detective or this incident.
Kaede...

Well, detective, if you do solve this case, it'll
really help us out.

We're only in this mess because the culprit
refused to step forward.

Let's go, Shuichi! We still have more people
to talk to!
Y-Yeah...

Well, detective, if you do solve this case, it'll
really help us out.

We're only in this mess because the culprit
refused to step forward.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't leave yet... There are still things
I need to investigate.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor was displaying a countdown
leading up to the time limit expiring...

<CLT=cltMIND>But then the countdown stopped, and that
obnoxious noise went away, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...

Hey, Shuichi... The A/V Room is that room
in the back, right?
Kaede...have you never been in there before?
Nope, not yet. Anyway, let's go.
<CLT=cltMIND>We need to confirm Maki's alibi.
